name: leader-list
title: Leader list
description: Rows with a dotted leader between the name and the value, for menus, schedules, receipts and tables of contents.
docs: items are the rows: a label, a value and an optional detail (a quieter line under the label), with an id when two labels could be the same. leader is dots (the default), dashes or line; size is sm, md or lg. as="ul" (the default) renders a list, as="dl" renders term and description pairs. The label and the value can be any node, so a total can be bold and a chapter number muted. The leader is CSS: it starts a little after the last word of the label and stops before the value, a long label wraps onto a second line while the leader and the value stay on its last line, and the value never wraps and uses tabular figures. The leader is hidden from assistive technology, and it follows the writing direction, so it works right to left.
